locomotionCriteria.scope: Engineering acceptance for this one nominal flat six-leg body; not a paper benchmark or robustness study.
locomotionCriteria.stability: All 600 control steps, finite state, zero warning increments/time resets, no ground-relative fall.
locomotionCriteria.note: Lateral/heading drift is measured and reported; passing does not certify precise navigation.

limitations: Single deterministic nominal body and initial state.
Only exported six foot colliders; no obstacle/manipulation evidence.
Fixtures use native CPU float32 reference math, not captured GPU Warp states.
Browser rendering, UI lifecycle and physical touch remain separate checks.
